thread:
Anna: Heads-up — Saturn (HW partner) reported Marketplace usage counts not matching their invoice. Raw events show ~12% more units for Feb 28-29.
Miguel: Looking at ingestion logs, I see duplicate webhook POSTs with same usage_id but different timestamps. Possibly retries from partner region failover.
Miguel: sample payload:
```
{
  "usage_id": "u-9a2b3c",
  "customer": "saturn-inc",
  "units": 1200,
  "timestamp": "2026-02-28T23:59:45Z"
}
```
Raj: We currently dedupe on (usage_id, customer) within a 5m sliding window during ingestion. If partner retries after >5m we re-ingest.
Claire: Partner claims their system only emitted one event. They forwarded their logs showing a 503 from marketplace endpoint at 23:59:50 which triggered their retry logic.
Anna: Thoughts: should we extend dedupe window to 30m or add idempotency token check? Also need to reconcile billed units vs ledger before adjustments.
Raj: Extending to 30m risks suppressing legitimate late reports. Better: check idempotency header X-Usage-Token if present, fallback to usage_id.
Miguel: We don't currently persist X-Usage-Token. Quick fix: add ingestion step to normalize token -> usage_id mapping and backfill for last 7 days.
billing-bot: processed_events=1,243,912, duplicate_suppression=4,320 (last 24h)
Sam: Legal — don't issue credits automatically. Need signed adjustment request from partner + PS validation.
Claire: I'll ask Saturn to produce signed CSV of suspected duplicate usage with timestamps. Also ask for their retry/backoff policy.
Anna: Proposed plan:
1) Miguel: implement idempotency-token support + backfill script (ETA 48h)
2) Raj: deploy dedupe config change to reading layer to prefer token (ETA 24h)
3) Claire: collect partner artifacts and signed adjustment request (ETA 48h)
4) Billing team: run reconcile job for Feb 26-29 and produce delta report (ETA 72h)
5) Coordinator call with Saturn tomorrow 10am PT — @saturn-ps (invite sent)
Miguel: I'll open PR today and link tests. If we find more partners with similar retries, we can expose guidance in partner onboarding doc.
Anna: OK. @raj @miguel please ping here when PR and prod deploys are done. I'll track partner comms. :thumbsup:
